title: Future of AI Lab
tagline: Explore AI careers and build the future
objectives: See how AI transforms every field
Match AI jobs to what they do
Sort AI project ideas by difficulty
Know what a good AI solution needs

stages.title: Build the Future!
stages.narration: AI is creating exciting new careers and changing almost every field. You don't have to wait until you're grown up to start exploring, let's look at the future you could help build!

steps.text: It's transforming healthcare, space, and farming.
Real problems are waiting for smart solutions.
And you could be the one who builds them!

stages.title: Match the AI Job
stages.prompt: Different people build AI. Who does each job?

tasks.label: Builds AI-powered apps and systems
tasks.explain: AI Engineers design and build the AI systems we use.

tasks.label: Digs through data to find hidden patterns
tasks.explain: Data Scientists find insights and patterns in data.

tasks.label: Designs robots that sense and move
Cleans and analyzes huge datasets
tasks.explain: Working with big datasets is a Data Scientist's specialty.

tasks.label: Programs a robot arm to sort parcels
tasks.explain: Making robots act in the real world is robotics engineering.

stages.title: AI Across Every Field
stages.prompt: AI isn't just for tech companies. Tap each field to see how AI helps. Visit them all!

locations.label: Healthcare
locations.info: AI spots diseases early by reading scans and patient data.

locations.label: Space
locations.info: AI guides rovers on Mars and plans safe routes across other worlds.

locations.label: Education
locations.info: Personal AI tutors help students learn at their own pace.

locations.label: Agriculture
locations.info: AI helps farmers grow more food and catch crop problems early.

locations.label: Environment
locations.info: AI tracks climate change and helps protect wildlife.

stages.title: Pick Your Project Level
stages.prompt: Ready to build? Sort these AI project ideas by how tricky they are to make.
stages.note: Start small, then level up! Every expert began with a beginner project.

stages.title: Design an AI Solution
stages.prompt: You're designing an AI to solve a real problem. Tap everything a good AI solution needs.

items.label: The right data to learn from

feedback.correct: Yes! Great AI solutions start with a real problem and the right data.
feedback.incorrect: An AI can't run on this, it needs a real problem, data, and a clear goal.

stages.title: Future Builder Final Test
stages.prompt: Score at least 80% to earn your Future Builder badge and finish the course!

questions.explain: A Data Scientist finds patterns in data, one of many AI careers.

questions.q: Which field can AI help improve?
questions.explain: AI is transforming many fields across the real world.

questions.q: What's a good first step to design an AI solution?
options: Pick a real problem and think about the data it needs
Wait for someone else to do it
questions.explain: Great AI projects start with a real problem and the right data.
Robotics Engineers build robots that sense and move.
Data Scientists dig through data to find useful patterns.

questions.q: AI in the future will most likely...
options: Create new jobs and transform many fields
questions.explain: AI keeps opening new careers and reshaping industries.

questions.q: A good beginner AI project is...
options: A full self-driving car from scratch
questions.explain: Start small, an AI Quiz Bot is a perfect first build.
